967. Triangle Area Calculation-2

40

Medium

Problem Statement:
You are required to write a program that calculates and prints the area of a triangle given its base and height. Implement a class named 'Triangle' without any parameter in its constructor.
input_spec: The input consists of two lines. Each line contains an integer representing either the base or the height of the triangle.
output_spec: Output the area of the triangle.
